name: zgeometry_weiler_clip_point_list
description: zGeometry_Weiler::ClipPointList initializes clip output state, handles preclassified contour relationships, dispatches the Weiler clipping pipeline, and restores caller-visible output state.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the top-level bad-parameter, disjoint, identical-contour, and contained-contour preclassification paths directly; deeper intersection merge behavior is covered through the accepted functional targets for ClassifyContainedContour, MergeContours, NewContour, OutputContoursForClipMode, GenerateOutsideResults, RestorePointTranslation, and RestoreOutputZFromInputPlane.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x464810 validates the bad-parameter gate, inputContourB base/count setup, clipMode write, optional axis toggle and recenter calls, polygon/point output buffer initialization, outClip field initialization, ClassifyInputContourPairBounds dispatch, preclassified return modes 1/3/4, cleanup/error paths, full Weiler pipeline dispatch, output contour gathering, restore-output-z calls, and final return modes.

The native clip leaf smoke verifies the bad-parameter return, preclassified disjoint return with initialized empty output, identical-contour output to polygonSetA, and contained-contour outside-output path with polygonSetA/polygonSetB spans and aggregate point-list count.
